Container.Name: Slipstream
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Formula 1 live timing and historical replay. Full mode includes the Slipstream browser UI, REST API, and WebSocket; api-only provides headless REST API and WebSocket access. Draft template for private testing.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent application-data root: catalog, replay/session data, operational and Pirelli state, and future database/settings. Must be writable by the built-in slipstream user (UID 10001).

Config.Name: Runtime Mode
Config.Description: full = browser UI + REST API/WebSocket (recommended); api-only = headless REST API/WebSocket for custom clients/integrations.

Config.Name: Catalog Years
Config.Description: Number of recent Formula 1 seasons included in Slipstream's session catalog.
